message.content: [{"counter_argument":"'Test argument' is too vague to support any conclusion: it gives no explicit claim, premises, or evidence, so one should withhold acceptance until the speaker specifies the proposition and backing for it.","strategy_used":"highlight_ambiguity","target_argument":"Test argument","strength":"moderate","reasoning":"Pointing out vagueness effectively undermines acceptance because arguments require clear premises and evidence; exposing the lack of content prevents drawing unwarranted conclusions and prompts clarification."}]
